recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It removes the remaining discovered current-source stale references from the Observation.name rename family without changing the established resource definition or broadening into separate DiagnosticReport or profiling cleanups.
issue_request: FHIR-5276 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 OO ballot change request to rename Observation.name to Observation.code because the element represents a coded observation identifier rather than a human-readable name.
initial_application: Git commit d6259fa8e3beda8fd5e58ad54d85001f1efb9d42 explicitly applied #5276 by changing Observation.name to Observation.code across Observation source, profiles, and examples. The current active Observation StructureDefinition already uses Observation.code, and source/fhir.ini lists Observation as active while DeviceObservationReport is only in removed resources.
additional_context: FHIR-9651 later fixed one profiling.html sentence that still referred to a target resource name element after the rename, and b6a5fbd68ee31141b18a69a7a43fcbb2b85140b4 applied that exact correction. Current profiling.html still had nearby examples using Observation.name and item.resolve().name for Observation-oriented discriminator examples. Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found the missed-reference family and no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/profiling.html so the affected slicing/discriminator examples use Observation.code.extension, Observation.code, and item.resolve().code. No Observation StructureDefinition edit was needed because the authoritative element definition is already Observation.code.
